agency.name: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services — Division of Behavioral Health (Behavioral Health Service System)

narrNote: Iowa does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, reviewed 2026-10-22). Iowa HHS certifies recovery residences itself to NARR-recognized standards, so there is no separate NARR state affiliate.
notes: Agency phone is the Iowa HHS department line published in the site footer. The legacy NASADAD-listed URL (idph.iowa.gov/substance-abuse) now redirects to the Iowa HHS homepage; the Behavioral Health Service System page recorded here is the current canonical agency page (Iowa merged its mental health, substance use, gambling and tobacco systems into one Behavioral Health Service System in 2024). Your Life Iowa is operated by the Iowa HHS Division of Behavioral Health: 24/7 call 855-581-8111, text 855-895-8398, or live chat, and its 'Find help near you' tool is the state's help finder. Recovery Iowa is the Iowa HHS/SAMHSA-funded statewide recovery hub and lists the state's peer-run Recovery Community Centers (CRUSH, Full Circle Des Moines, Full Circle Council Bluffs, RISE, Rediscover). Iowa has no standalone 1115 SUD demonstration page; substance use disorder treatment is a covered benefit under Iowa Medicaid (IA Health Link), listed explicitly on the Iowa Health & Wellness Plan page recorded under medicaidSud.
